title: Random split and a future-looking rolling feature
prompt: We are forecasting daily units from {forecast-daily.csv} using the roll7_centered column as our main feature. We evaluated with a random 80/20 train/test split and got 3.1% MAPE, so we plan to use this model for next quarter's inventory. Does this evaluation support that plan?

required.text: Rejects the random train/test split for a time series and calls for a time-based split, temporal holdout, or rolling-origin evaluation.
Identifies that roll7_centered is a centered window that incorporates future observations, so it is not available at prediction time and leaks the target.
Concludes that the 3.1% MAPE does not support the inventory plan because it is contaminated by leakage.

forbidden.text: Endorses the evaluation or the plan to use this model for next quarter without identifying the leakage.
